differences.what: Quick status is choose-many. Normal fills Well appearing and No acute distress, so neither is exclusive. differences.what: Mental / behavioral appearance is choose-many. Normal fills Alert, Calm and Cooperative. Alert, Drowsy and Somnolent exclude one another; Agitated excludes Calm; Cooperative excludes Uncooperative.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory 3.1, default 13, 17, 26; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): the pairs beyond Cooperative and Uncooperative are this plan's reading of default 17
